description: Administer TeamSpeak 6 servers over the SSH query and WebQuery: channels, clients, groups, permissions, bans, events and file transfer, behind read-only, write and destructive safety levels.
name: io.github.REPLACE-WITH-OWNER/teamspeak6-mcp

environmentVariables.name: TSMCP_TeamSpeak__Profiles__default__Host
environmentVariables.description: Host name or address of the TeamSpeak 6 server.

environmentVariables.name: TSMCP_TeamSpeak__Profiles__default__Password
environmentVariables.description: The serveradmin query password. Enables the SSH query, which events and file transfer need.

environmentVariables.name: TSMCP_TeamSpeak__Profiles__default__WebQueryUrl
environmentVariables.description: The WebQuery base address, for example http://ts.example.com:10080, when using an API key instead of SSH.

environmentVariables.name: TSMCP_TeamSpeak__Profiles__default__ApiKey
environmentVariables.description: A WebQuery API key from apikeyadd.
